subject: Showcase story arc & demo snippets — AI Infra Summit
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@edgecloud.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30T09:12:00Z
Subject: Showcase story arc & demo snippets — AI Infra Summit

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the speaking invite — excited for Redwood to be part of the AI Infrastructure Summit. I wanted to share a concise plan for the booth/stage deliverables so we can lock on what you need from us by next Tuesday. High-level asks: 

- 10-minute on-stage demo clip (30-60s highlight reel too)
- 1-page customer narrative / case summary for the event program
- PDF of the 12-slide deck we’ll run on stage + speaker notes
- Logos (SVG/PNG) and AV arrival time for booth playback

Marissa is copied to coordinate assets. I’ve attached an initial demo rough cut (demo_snippets_v1.mp4) and a working case template we used for a prior summit. Can you confirm: final file format you prefer for the 10-min clip, and the latest drop-dead date for program collateral?

Also, please confirm the stage AV spec (frame size/codecs) and whether we can load media to your on-site player ahead of time.

Thanks — I’ll sync Marissa on internal deadlines once we hear back.

Best,
Sergio
VP, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachment: demo_snippets_v1.mp4 (video/stub)
Attachment: case_template_base.docx (docx/stub)

From: Elena Martinez <elena@edgecloud.io>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@finlytics.com>
Cc: AI Infra Summit Production <production@ai-infra-summit.org>
Date: 2027-05-30T11:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Showcase story arc & demo snippets — AI Infra Summit

Hi Sergio — great to hear from you and glad Redwood is on board. Quick answers below: 

- File formats: MP4 H.264 for the main clip, 1080p; a separate 30-60s highlight clip as MP4 is ideal.
- Program collateral deadline: June 7th (COB) to guarantee inclusion in the printed program.
- AV: We accept uploads to our media portal (link below). Please submit by June 9th for checks.

We’d also like a one-page customer narrative that highlights measurable results (latency reduction and cost per inference) — if you can frame the FinLytics work as a short problem → solution → outcomes arc, that would be perfect. I’ve looped in Samir from FinLytics (he’s ok with a short case write-up and can approve quotes).

Portal link: https://ai-infra-summit.org/media-upload

Elena
Event Director, EdgeCloud Events

P.S. Production will confirm exact codec/container windowside, but H.264 is the safe bet.

--- Forwarded message ---
From: AI Infra Summit Production <production@ai-infra-summit.org>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@edgecloud.io>
Date: 2027-05-30T11:29:00Z
Subject: AV spec

Sergio/Redwood team — for quick reference: Preferred format MP4 (H.264), resolution 1920x1080, AAC audio, single file per segment. Max file size 2GB. Upload portal required for playback testing.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30T13:00:00Z
Subject: Re: Showcase story arc & demo snippets — AI Infra Summit

Thanks Sergio / Elena for the clarity. Quick internal plan and owners below — keeping it short so we can move to production: 

- Demo video (owner: Marissa) — produce full 10-min demo + 45s highlight reel. Need final run-through with Sergio by June 3. Deliver MP4 H.264 1080p to portal by June 7. (Attachment: slides_ai-infra_draft.pdf for reference)
- Customer case study (owner: Laura) — draft targeted at the program one-pager (max 400 words). Laura to coordinate quotes with Samir; Laura will use case_study_finlytics_draft.docx as starter. Deadline: June 5 for internal review.
- Speaker slides + notes (owner: Hannah) — produce a 10-slide deck with 3 demo screenshots and speaker cue notes. Draft due June 4.
- On-site ops (owner: Sergio) — coordinate whether we ship a USB or upload; confirm AV arrival time by June 9.

Action items: 
1) Laura: open case draft and ping Samir for a 20-minute approval call (can do next week).
2) Hannah: convert deck to PDF for quick share; include timestamps for the demo video.
3) Marissa: produce a 45s highlight reel for the booth loop in parallel with the long cut.

I attached the current slide draft and the FinLytics case template to speed up edits. We should keep language measurement-focused (latency, cost per inference, deployment time).

Marissa
Senior Field Marketing Manager — Redwood Inference

Attachments: slides_ai-infra_draft.pdf (pdf/stub); case_study_finlytics_draft.docx (docx/stub)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@edgecloud.io>, Samir Patel <samir@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-31T08:45:00Z
Subject: Final asset drop & approvals — AI Infra Summit deliverables

Hi Elena / Samir — thanks for the fast turn. Attaching the first cut of deliverables; Marissa and team will iterate after your feedback.

Deliverables attached / links: 
- Demo (10:00) — demo_clip_v2.mp4 (attached) and 45s highlight uploaded to portal: https://ai-infra-summit.org/media-upload/entry/REDWOOD_45s
- Case summary (draft) — case_study_finlytics_draft.docx attached; Laura will take comments and update.
- Speaker deck (draft) — slides_ai-infra_draft.pdf attached for quick review.

Samir — if you can confirm the highlighted quote on page 2 of the case draft and sign off on the metrics (20% latency reduction, 3x throughput improvement) that would let us finalize for the program. If we don’t hear back by June 5 we’ll assume approval to publish the numbers as-is for the event program.

Next steps: Marissa will run a final A/V compatibility check on June 9 and confirm playback method. Hannah will finalize speaker notes and send the final PDF on June 4.

Thanks — sending this from my mailbox for centralized approvals.

Sergio
VP, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachments: demo_clip_v2.mp4 (video/stub); case_study_finlytics_draft.docx (docx/stub); slides_ai-infra_draft.pdf (pdf/stub)
